verdict.rationale: A business-registry and filing service could plausibly offer event subscriptions, such as entity-status changes or filing confirmations, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Filing runs through PDF forms, upload/fax/mail and a CAPTCHA-gated portal, results are returned by mail, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
